rationale: Injury and press updates confirm Erling Haaland asked to come off after 67 minutes for Norway with muscle fatigue (BBC Sport, Manchester Evening News). Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca confirmed on 9 October that Haaland is fit and ready for Anfield, but facing Liverpool away with recent fatigue makes handing him the captaincy unnecessary when Bruno Fernandes is fully fit, on penalties, and hosting Tottenham Hotspur at Old Trafford. Bruno takes the captaincy with Haaland as vice-captain. Meanwhile, Dane Scarlett has permanently transferred to Leyton Orient, leaving a non-playing slot on our bench. With 15 tenths in the bank and 1 free transfer, we sell Scarlett (45 tenths) and buy Rodrigo Muniz (54 tenths), leaving 6 tenths in the bank with zero hits. Muniz steps into the starting eleven to exploit Fulham's excellent fixture run (Ipswich away, Hull home, Coventry away), enabling us to bench Dominic Calvert-Lewin away against Arsenal's stout defense. In defence, Frank Lampard confirmed Milan van Ewijk returned to training after his minor hamstring issue, providing sound depth alongside Luke Shaw and Forster on the bench. Looking ahead, Gameweek 7 offers Haaland a standout captaincy fixture at home to Ipswich, where we plan to transfer Leif Davis (facing Man City away) to Antonee Robinson (hosting Hull) for 45 tenths, leaving 1 tenth in the bank. In Gameweek 8, we bank our transfer to accumulate two free transfers for future gameweeks while backing our strong core.
